description: This file provides functions for visualizing and analyzing CUDA memory usage in PyTorch, including flamegraph generation, memory segment analysis, and trace visualization.

classes.name: Bytes
classes.description: A class representing byte sizes with human-readable formatting.

methods.name: _frame_fmt
methods.description: Formats a frame dictionary into a string with filename, line, and function.

methods.name: _frame_filter
methods.description: Filters out frames based on function names and filenames to exclude internal or irrelevant frames.

methods.name: _frames_fmt
methods.description: Formats a list of frames into strings, optionally reversing order.

methods.name: _block_extra_legacy
methods.description: Extracts frames and size info from legacy block format.

methods.name: _block_extra
methods.description: Extracts frames and size info from current block format.

methods.name: format_flamegraph
methods.description: Generates a flamegraph visualization from flamegraph lines, downloading the script if necessary.

methods.name: _write_blocks
methods.description: Writes block information into a file-like object for visualization.

methods.name: segments
methods.description: Creates a flamegraph of memory segments from a snapshot.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Creates a flamegraph of memory usage from a snapshot.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Creates a flamegraph comparing two memory snapshots.

methods.name: _format_size
methods.description: Converts a number of bytes into a human-readable string.

methods.name: calc_active
methods.description: Calculates total active allocated size in a segment.

methods.name: _report_free
methods.description: Reports total free memory with internal percentage.

methods.name: segsum
methods.description: Provides a detailed textual summary of memory segments and fragmentation.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Generates a trace visualization of memory events over time.

methods.name: _format_viz
methods.description: Formats data into an HTML visualization with embedded memory snapshot.

methods.name: filter_alloc_free_pairs
methods.description: Filters out paired alloc/free events from trace data for clearer visualization.

methods.name: trace_plot
methods.description: Creates an HTML visualization of memory usage over time, with options for filtering and segmentation.

methods.name: _profile_to_snapshot
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch profiler profile into a memory snapshot for visualization.

methods.name: segment_plot
methods.description: Creates a visualization of allocator segment states.
